candidate_provenance.original_picture_brief: Show a compact payment reader and a plain bank card held near its contactless area. Keep the reader dominant, with the card close enough to explain its purpose. Distinguish it from a pistol-shaped barcode scanner, a full register, and a standalone keypad. Omit account numbers, merchant branding, PIN entry, and operating steps.
candidate_provenance.proposed_picture_brief: Show a compact bank-card payment reader with a plain card close to the reader, a small screen, a keypad and a secondary receipt. Keep the compact device dominant. Exclude a full cash drawer, merchant branding, readable account numbers, PIN entry and operating instructions. The picture does not claim a particular card-reading method or a completed payment.
